* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), slip 160: “USED: If you just hit a target with a non-lightsaber non-[Permanent Weapon] weapon, place target (and all cards on it) in owner's Used Pile. LOST: Cancel Heroic (and any immunity to attrition) on a character or starship this turn.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the original text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026), slip checked).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). * '''PC-E1''' ([[Precise Hit (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) rewrote the text (“may place target”; “LOST: Target a Heroic character or starship. It loses Heroic and/or immunity to attrition, if any, this turn.”): “USED: If you just hit a target with a non-lightsaber non-[Permanent Weapon] weapon, may place target (and all cards on it) in owner's Used Pile. LOST: Target a Heroic character or starship. It loses Heroic and/or immunity to attrition, if any, this turn.”<ref name="cl-1210_159-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
